name: a remote module's missing manifests are asked for once
a single-shot pool delivers every message

given.pool.yml:
runtime:
  max_actors: 1000000
groups:
  dispatcher:
    seed: ["go"]
    code: |
      from actor import send
      receive()
      i = 0
      while i < 20000:
          send("workers", str(i))
          i = i + 1
  workers:
    replicas: 1000000
    code: |
      m = receive()
      print("ok", m)

name: thousands of actors share the std packages

given.pool.yml:
runtime:
  max_actors: 1000000
groups:
  dispatcher:
    seed: ["go"]
    code: |
      from actor import send
      receive()
      i = 0
      while i < 3000:
          send("workers", str(i))
          i = i + 1
  workers:
    replicas: 1000000
    code: |
      import json, re, math, struct
      m = receive()
      print("ok", json.dumps([m]), math.floor(2.5), struct.calcsize("i"))
